title: `torch.sparse.log_softmax` crash with `Floating point exception (core dumped)` in PyTorch 1.12.0

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: module: cuda
labels.description: Related to torch.cuda, and CUDA support in general

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug In PyTorch 1.12.0, `torch.sparse.log_softmax` will crash directly with the specific input on Cuda device , without any valid error message returned. Similar problems also occur in 1.11.0 or earlier versions. The root cause seems to be similar to [#82107](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/82107) ### To Reproduce ```python import torch input=torch.sparse_coo_tensor([[]], [], (3,), device='cuda') def test(): result=torch.sparse.log_softmax(input,0) return result print(test()) ``` The error result is ``` Floating point exception (core dumped) ``` ### Expected behavior Not crash, return empty tensor or print error message. ### Versions
